{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|We've got concussions, a fractured arm, a hand with no meat on it, and our medics are tied up removing a rib from a lung.|Lieutenant Piloc|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Ribs''' were the supporting structure of a being's chest anatomy. The large lizard-like [[Brezak/Legends|brezaks]] had a flexible rib cage, allowing them to deploy their skin flaps in order to glide through the air.<ref name="SWE Brezak">{{SWE|characters|brezak|brezak}}</ref> The [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Cradossk/Legends|Cradossk]], former leader of the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]], kept the ribs of his vanquished foes in his [[Memory bone chamber|bone chamber]].<ref name="TMA">''[[The Mandalorian Armor]]''</ref>

"Ribs" also described the meat surrounding the [[Bone/Legends|rib cage]] that were often eaten as a delicacy. Types of ribs included [[Dewback ribs]], [[karkan ribene]]s and [[traladon ribs]].
